content.short: Cardano Sights is a series of digital art collections of the most iconic and inspirational places across the globe.
content.description: Cardano Sights is a series of digital art collections which will consist of 999 landmark NFTs, all monumental to each place and its history. Each piece of art is unique. Landmarks give us a sense of place. These monuments and natural wonders connect us to a destination and inspire travel. In Paris, it's the Eiffel Tower, and in New York City it's the Statue of Liberty. Explore the globe in search of these intriguing historic sights.
content.meta: Find out about Cardano Sights (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
